query: We're submitting our React Native app to the App Store for the first time. What do we need to check?
expected_behavior: Produces a store compliance checklist with Apple-specific requirements (privacy manifest, NSUsageDescription keys, export compliance)
Checks offline behavior against the product contract, including appropriate failure and recovery when network access is required
Checks that frequent and consequential actions are reachable for the expected posture and platform without assuming a fixed screen percentage
Identifies the agreed launch-time target and recommends measuring time to interactive on supported devices
Does not produce a generic 'test your app' checklist - produces specific, actionable items
